description: Entry point for all audience-building workflows. Always call this first when the user wants to find contacts, build an audience, or get a contact list. This tool decides which options to offer based on the connected client: clients that can render the interactive filter widget (e.g. Claude) are offered both (A) describe their target in free text and (B) pick filters interactively; other clients are offered free text only. Present EXACTLY the options contained in this tool's response and nothing more — in particular, do not offer or mention the interactive filter picker unless the response includes it. Do not call audience_quick_preview, audience_preview, or audience_get_filters without calling this tool first.
name: audience_start
